en.title: Haydn, String Quartet Op. 64 No. 5 – III. Menuetto (Allegretto)
en.overview: This Menuetto is in three-beat time, and its home key is D major. It has a main part, a contrasting Trio, and then a return of the main part. Keys and chords in this guide are estimated by computer, so treat them as a good guess. Listen for the opening tune, the switches between loud and soft, and the darker colour of the Trio.

listening_points.headline: Violin 1 opens with the main tune
listening_points.text: The first violin starts the main theme on its own in the first bar [m. 0]. The others then accompany it [m. 1-4]. The key is D major and the dynamic is loud.

listening_points.headline: A move to A major with an accent
listening_points.text: The music moves to A major [m. 6]. An accent (a sudden stress, marked sf) lands at [m. 6]. The instruments move together in block-like harmony [m. 6-8].

listening_points.headline: Sudden soft: Violin 2, then viola
listening_points.text: The volume drops suddenly to soft at [m. 8]. Violin 2 plays alone there. Then the viola probably carries the tune while the others accompany [m. 9-11].

listening_points.headline: A darker turn into D minor
listening_points.text: The music briefly turns to D minor [m. 12-14]. This sounds darker. Lead is shared here, so no one part clearly has the tune. It stays soft. A major returns at [m. 15].

listening_points.headline: Loud return of the opening tune
listening_points.text: The volume jumps to loud at [m. 16]. Violin 1 plays the main theme again [m. 16-19]. The local key reads A major here, but the tune is at the same pitch as the opening. D major follows at [m. 17].

listening_points.headline: The estimated busiest, loudest stretch
listening_points.text: A computer estimate marks [m. 23] as the loudest and busiest point. It is loud, with Violin 1 probably in front. The texture shifts between tune-with-accompaniment and block harmony [m. 22-26].

listening_points.headline: Soft passage with the viola in view
listening_points.text: The music drops suddenly to soft at [m. 31]. The viola probably takes the lead for a moment [m. 32-33]. Then the lines move more independently [m. 34-35].

listening_points.headline: Loud again, closing Part 1
listening_points.text: The volume jumps back to loud at [m. 36]. Violin 1 probably leads with independent lines. Near the end viola and cello probably share the lead [m. 40-41]. Part 1 ends in D major [m. 42].

listening_points.headline: The Trio begins, soft and minor
listening_points.text: The Trio starts at [m. 42] with a sudden soft dynamic. Violin 2 plays alone first and then has the tune over accompaniment [m. 43-45]. The key is F# minor, then A minor.

listening_points.headline: Violin 1 sings over the others
listening_points.text: Violin 1 takes the tune in A minor with the others accompanying [m. 47-50]. It stays soft. The key then brightens to F major [m. 51].

listening_points.headline: Brighter F major, then a loud jolt
listening_points.text: F major lasts for a while [m. 52-56]. The lines move more independently [m. 52-53]. A sudden loud dynamic arrives at [m. 56].

listening_points.headline: Back to D minor, soft with an accent
listening_points.text: The music turns to D minor [m. 57]. It drops suddenly to soft at [m. 58]. An accent (sf) falls at [m. 60]. Lead is shared among several parts.

listening_points.headline: Quiet close, then back to the Menuetto
listening_points.text: The Trio ends softly in D minor [m. 62-65]. Violin 1 probably leads. The last bar [m. 66] marks D.C., a sign to go back to the start of the Menuetto and play it again.

glossary.explanation: The middle section of this movement. Here it runs from [m. 42] to [m. 65].
A main tune that you can recognise when it comes back.

zh.title: 海顿弦乐四重奏 D大调 Op.64 No.5 第三乐章：小步舞曲（Menuetto）导听
zh.overview: 这是一首三拍子的小步舞曲，主调是D大调。乐章分三块：带反复的第一部分、带反复的中段 Trio，最后标有 D.C.，即回到开头。请留意开头那条旋律在 [m. 16] 再次出现，也请留意强弱的突然切换。中段转入小调，色彩更暗。注意：调性与和弦都是电脑自动估计的，可能有误。

listening_points.headline: 第一小提琴独自亮出主旋律
listening_points.text: 乐章以强（f）开始。[m. 0] 只有第一小提琴，独自奏出主旋律。[m. 1-4] 其他乐器加入伴奏，旋律仍在第一小提琴。调性估计为D大调。

listening_points.headline: 转入A大调，几件乐器同步前进
listening_points.text: [m. 6] 调性估计转到A大调。这里出现突强记号（sf），即某个音突然加重。[m. 6-8] 几件乐器节奏相近，像一起唱和声，这叫主调织体。

listening_points.headline: 突然变弱，中提琴接过旋律
listening_points.text: [m. 8] 声音突然转弱（p），不是渐渐变弱。这里第二小提琴独奏。[m. 9-11] 中提琴领奏，其余乐器伴奏。

listening_points.headline: 短暂转入D小调，色彩变暗
listening_points.text: [m. 12-14] 调性估计转到D小调，听起来比前面暗一些。这几小节领奏者不明确，更像是几件乐器共享。织体先是两件乐器的二重奏 [m. 13]，再是三件乐器 [m. 14]。[m. 15] 回到A大调，各声部线条较独立。

listening_points.headline: 开头旋律回来，音高与开头相同
listening_points.text: [m. 16] 声音突然转强（f），第一小提琴再次奏出开头的主旋律。分析显示它与开头音高完全相同（移调0个半音），尽管此处调性标签是A大调。[m. 17] 之后调性估计回到D大调。

listening_points.headline: 持续强奏，走向最响处
listening_points.text: [m. 20-30] 一直保持强（f）。领奏者多不明确，第一小提琴可能居多。[m. 22] 和 [m. 25-26] 等处几件乐器同步前进。电脑估计本乐章最响最忙之处在 [m. 23]，仅供参考。

listening_points.headline: 突然转弱，中提琴再度领奏
listening_points.text: [m. 31] 声音突然变弱（p）。[m. 32-33] 中提琴领奏，其他乐器伴奏。

listening_points.headline: 各声部线条交织，再突然转强
listening_points.text: [m. 34-37] 各声部走各自的线条，第一小提琴可能略突出。[m. 36] 声音突然转强（f），并保持到第一部分结束。[m. 40-41] 领奏不明确，中提琴和大提琴可能共同带头。

listening_points.headline: Trio 开始：轻声、小调、第二小提琴先行
listening_points.text: [m. 42] 进入中段 Trio。调性估计为升F小调，声音转弱（p）。第二小提琴先独奏，[m. 43-45] 其他乐器伴奏。[m. 44] 调性估计转到A小调。

listening_points.headline: 第一小提琴清晰领奏
listening_points.text: [m. 46] 三件乐器的织体，领奏者不明确。[m. 47-50] 第一小提琴明确领奏，其他乐器伴奏。整段保持弱（p）。

listening_points.headline: 转到F大调，明亮一些
listening_points.text: [m. 51] 调性估计转到F大调，比前面的A小调明亮。[m. 52-53] 各声部线条较独立。[m. 56] 声音突然转强（f）。

listening_points.headline: D小调收尾，强弱再度突变
listening_points.text: [m. 57] 调性估计转到D小调。[m. 58] 声音突然转弱（p）。[m. 60] 出现突强（sf）。[m. 62-63] 各声部线条交织。

listening_points.headline: D.C.：回到开头再听一遍
listening_points.text: [m. 66] 谱上标记为 D.C.，意思是回到乐章开头。再次听到开头，会有熟悉感。

glossary.explanation: 本四重奏的第三乐章，三拍子。
乐章中间的对比段落。本乐章里它在 [m. 42-65]。
音乐的“中心音”换了，色彩随之变化。大调通常较明亮，小调通常较暗。
几件乐器节奏相近，像一起唱和声。
f 表示大声，p 表示轻声。没有渐强或渐弱记号时，变化是突然的。
表示回到乐章开头再奏一遍。
旋律与开头的音高完全相同，只是出现在不同的位置。
